hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); pattern=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -E -o 'rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+/|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+(--force|-f)([[:space:]]+(origin[[:space:]]+)?main([[:space:]]|$))|gh[[:space:]]+repo[[:space:]]+delete([[:space:]]|$)|gh[[:space:]]+secret[[:space:]]+delete([[:space:]]|$)' 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -n "$pattern" ]; then echo "BLOCKED by .claude/settings.json PreToolUse hook: matched dangerous pattern '$pattern'. If this command is genuinely needed, run it outside the agent or edit the regex in .claude/settings.json (and mirror the change in .github/hooks/pre-tool-use.json)." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

input=$(cat); tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null); err=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_response.stderr // ""' 2>/dev/null); status=0; if [ -n "$err" ]; then status=1; fi; summary=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '(.tool_input.command // .tool_input.file_path // "") | tostring' 2>/dev/null | head -c 120 | tr '\n' ' '); mkdir -p .agent-scratch && printf '%s %s %s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$tool" "$status" "$summary" >> .agent-scratch/audit.log 2>/dev/null; exit 0
